title: Grateful Dead Live at Newcastle-Under-Lyme on 1970-05-24
source: MSR > CDR > PC > my edits in Goldwave > CDR > FLAC; patched with unknown MR > cassette > PC; further patched with shnid 6481

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture mastered by Simon Phillips, featuring a soaring Dark Star and strong early‑set highlights like Hard to Handle and The Other One.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear soundboard quality and careful mastering, making the performance easy to enjoy. Musically the show shines with an entrancing Dark Star, a punchy Hard to Handle, and a fireworks‑like transition into Attics of My Life, while a few numbers (Casey Jones, China > Rider) are noted as merely passable.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers give high marks (5 and 4 stars). The show is described as strong with several standout moments, and the recording is called “fabulous” and expertly mastered, yielding a rating in the good‑to‑great range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Simon Phillips’ mastering delivers a clear, balanced mix with no reported dropouts or muddiness; reviewers highlight the sound as “fabulous” and “crisp.”

show_quality.setlist_flow: A varied set with a deliberate early‑show pace that builds into a psychedelic Dark Star, punctuated by tight transitions (notably the Attics of My Life segue) and strong ensemble singing toward the end.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s playing is highlighted – he “picks up the pace” on Hard to Handle and drives the Dark Star groove.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil Lesh receives praise for his vocal contribution (“I love Phil's vocals”).
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir delivers a solid Me and My Uncle and leads the ensemble singing at the close.
